perceived availability of tobacco cessation services (i.e. pharmacotherapies such as nicotine replacement therapy and behavioral treatments such as cognitive behavioral therapy) was associated with the use of tobacco cessation services by counselors in their treatment programs and that this relationship was moderated by indicators of climate for change in the treatment programs.
